item.title: Best Self-Hosted IT Change Management Platforms 2026: iTop vs Request Tracker vs Znuny
item.description: IT change management is the backbone of any organization that needs to track, approve, and implement infrastructure modifications without causing service disruptions. Commercial ITIL platforms like ServiceNow, Jira Service Management, and BMC Helix can cost hundreds of dollars per user per month. Self-hosted open-source alternatives offer full ITIL-compliant change management workflows without licensing fees.
